quotes.name: Denise Carter
quotes.quote: The Fund was never hood-wide relief, and it was never housing — it is West Oakland businesses and neighbors, with the 23-day clock kept honest. I verified nothing by wishing it.

quotes.name: Brenda Okoro
quotes.quote: West Oakland gets a verified closeout and a faithful charter renewal — not a shortcut around the businesses and residents this fund serves.

quotes.name: Marcus Webb
quotes.quote: The closeout is published, the ordinance is on the calendar with the scope that works and the 23-day clock still running — the hearing record carries the proof, and the roll call belongs to the Council.

quotes.name: Marcus Webb
quotes.quote: The rent does not wait for the ordinance and the vote doesn't come before the analysis — West Oakland gets the legal-support record first, and the 23-day clock keeps running while it does.
